newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel must rethink Hebron pullout -Netanyahu aide.
newsitem.headline: Israel must rethink Hebron pullout -Netanyahu aide.

text.p: Israel must rethink its plans to hand over parts of the West Bank city of Hebron in light of gunfights that erupted between its soldiers and Palestinian police, a senior Israeli official said on Sunday.

"We must rethink whether it's worth adding another city to the rule of this...Palestinian police so that another city may be used to threaten us with war. Obviously we will have to think about Hebron in a different way than we did before," David Bar-Illan, an adviser to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, told Israel Radio.
